name: Tempest
author: Erin Carter
description: A near-invisible charcoal storm bank churns in the lower frame until lightning ignites deep inside it, backlighting stacked billow silhouettes in negative before the afterglow cools through the palette back to darkness.

params.label: Flash period
params.effect: Average seconds between lightning bursts — a restless active cell at min, long brooding waits at max.

params.label: Roil speed
params.effect: Churn rate of the cloud bank between flashes — barely-perceptible creep at min, visible boiling at max.

params.label: Afterglow
params.effect: Decay length of the post-flash glow — short snaps back to blackness, long lets the lit silhouettes linger and cool through the palette.

params.label: Detail scale
params.effect: CSS-pixel scale of the dominant cloud billows revealed by each flash, from fine scud to a few monumental masses.
